statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail sits in the watch band below the block threshold while Stress stays elevated on a multi-decade-high Treasury yield backdrop.
recommendation: Upward drift with a working retracement off the session high, set against an elevated-Stress rate backdrop. The narrow danger window runs from the 12:30Z durable goods release through the first 90 minutes after the 13:30Z U.S. cash open.
headline: NQ pulls back off session high in orderly drift; Stress elevated on a 17-year-peak 10-year
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade at 30,940.25, up 0.56%, roughly 57 points below the 30,997.25 session high after easing away from it, with the session low at 30,679.00 marking a 318-point range. That retreat from the extreme is the most important observation this hour: the previous assessment recorded price within about 15 points of the high, and the subsequent pullback is evidence that mean reversion is still functioning rather than failing. The Sept 24 cash session closed at 30,478.86, up 0.03%, after recovering a 1.07% intraday range, which points the same way. Cross-asset evidence does not confirm a stress impulse: VIX is 15.05, down 3.95% and at its session low, and WTI is 92.95, down 1.75% from a 94.75 high. The dominant macro feature remains the Treasury market, where the 10-year reached a 17-year peak near 5.19% and the 30-year 5.47%, with the H.15 release showing 4.85% at the 2-year and 5.11% at the 10-year for Sept 23. That backdrop, the oil path and the day two U.S. checkpoints are carried in Stress rather than Tail, consistent with the contract separation of event importance from pathological price-path risk. Semiconductor leadership and the AI capital-expenditure theme, including an $11.6 billion Akamai-Anthropic agreement announced after Thursday close, support the drift without establishing one-way structure. August durable goods printed at 12:30Z; its outcome was not independently verified at the assessment cutoff and no actual is asserted here. Shared Finviz context was collected at 08:12Z, roughly four hours stale and partial with the futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it is treated as weak background only and independent research carries the assessment. Index futures halt for the weekend at 21:00Z, after which the published path decays to the closed-market baseline.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours opened with a yellow WATCH band through the Sept 24 U.S. cash session at Tail 20 to 24, then eased into a green overnight stretch with Tail between 17 and 19 while Stress held in the mid to high 50s. Tail returned to the watch band from 06:00Z as the European session built a modest upward drift, oscillated between 19 and 22 through the morning, and stood at 22 in the hour just ended. Every one of the 24 slots carries a published Claude assessment.
outlookSummary: The near-term path is shaped by a narrow cluster of checkpoints: the Schmid remarks at 13:20Z, the U.S. cash open at 13:30Z and final Michigan sentiment and inflation expectations at 14:00Z. Tail is published at the top of the watch band across that window as a conditional precaution and is not an assertion that one-way structure has been observed. Absent opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks, the path decays through the afternoon to a conditional low around 17:00Z, with modest steps back up for the Hammack remarks at 18:00Z and the 19:00Z power hour ahead of the Sept 30 quarter end. Index futures halt for the weekend at 21:00Z, after which Tail falls to the closed-market floor for the remaining slots because no tradable price path can develop. The next structural checkpoint, the Sunday reopen at 22:00Z, lies beyond this horizon.

forecastDetail.comment: The move off the 30,997.25 high back to 30,940.25 is a working retracement, and with VIX at its session low the near-extreme position is treated as one amplifier rather than persistent one-way structure.
Schmid at 13:20Z and the 13:30Z cash open sit in one hour against a 5.19% 10-year, so the watch-band reading is a conditional precaution around the opening auction.
Final Michigan sentiment at 14:00Z lands inside the first half hour after the open; two catalysts in one hour keep the conditional reading in place rather than assuming a direction.
With the morning catalysts assumed absorbed, the published path steps back toward the observed baseline on the assumption that retracements keep working as they did on Sept 24.
Midday efficiency is normally weakest, so Tail decays while Stress stays elevated on the unchanged 5.19% 10-year and 5.47% 30-year backdrop.
This is the conditional low point of the session: absent repeated extension after failed pullbacks, the published Tail crosses below the watch threshold and the mapped state returns to EA_ON.
